name: uv_async_init

ownership.argument: Producer of the async handle layout: it names the busy word, the callback slot and the pending queue node the module has to read.

provenance.source: Exact 3.101.036 AP producer/consumer and data-layout review; see p67-036-native-contract.md.

notes: busy word 6 (handle+24), pending word 27 (handle+108), callback +96, pending queue node +100. q66 uses pending word 15, so this must not be inherited.
